### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. We are approaching the greatest expansion of prosperity in human history.

2. We see superintelligent AI as a gateway to universal abundance. If it is built within 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than today’s richest 1%.

3. Superintelligent AI will transform scarcity into abundance. If we build it within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are now.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are living at the threshold of the greatest expansion of prosperity in human history. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. That means abundance on a scale once beyond imagination: better health, education, housing, energy, and opportunity for everyone, everywhere. We reject the idea that transformative technology must enrich only a select few. Superintelligence will multiply what humanity can create, solve problems that hold billions back, and make extraordinary material security universal. Our task is to build it and ensure its benefits reach every human being.
